verdict.rationale: HMRC clearly runs a sanctioned system-to-system rail. Making Tax Digital filing must go through compatible third-party software, and a live, versioned production REST API platform answers probes with a structured header and auth error contract. However, the developer hub that would document the software-provider enrollment path (app registration, production credentials, recognition) is hidden from crawlers and was not fetched, so the published enrollment path for software vendors is not evidenced. The only enrollment path in the pack is the taxpayer or agent sign-up flow. Missing for 10: documented software-vendor or transmitter enrollment and approval path, API documentation content, system or service-account credential model, independent corroboration of vendor onboarding.
